description: Lists issues with optional filters. Returns structured list with issue number, state, title, labels, assignees, author, creation date, and milestone.

labels.description: Filter by multiple labels (each maps to --label)

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return (default: 30)

milestone.description: Filter by milestone name or number (-m/--milestone)

paginate.description: Fetch a larger paginated set (up to 1000 issues)

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

repo.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO format (--repo). Default: current repo.

search.description: GitHub search syntax (-S/--search). A search using OR is grouped in parentheses so results stay in the repository

name: issue-list
title: Issue List
